about: WCAG 2.2 AA conformance records for the criteria axe cannot check (#301). One record per core screen and criterion: status pass, fail or na, evidence, and an issue link for each fail. tests/unit/wcag22-conformance-records.test.js lists the required screens and criteria. Records whose evidence starts with 'ci:' are asserted by that spec in CI; the others are manual reviews.

keyboard-focus-order.evidence: ci: tests/landing-e2e/landing-conformance-wcag22.spec.ts › conformance landing: keyboard-focus-order (Tab walk at 1440px: skip link first, DOM order, visible focus indicator, no positive tabindex)

HTML ships data-motion=on, which outranks the OS setting in app.js, and the infinite aurora background runs with no stop control

public-tracking.name: Public tracking (docs/marketing/landing-v2/track.html): lookup, verify, results, request forms and the map dialog, EN and AR
